workflow: A fresh production DXF is imported into the immutable KDraw document and exported again; source, direct roundtrip and exact Chromium roundtrip bytes are compared and each is opened independently with strict ezdxf 1.4.3.
result: All three 13679-byte files had SHA-256 28de58b3... and identical 40/40 per-handle semantic hashes. Independent read-back preserved two bulged polylines, seven HATCH records and loops, aligned DIMENSION points, millimetres, layers, linetypes, styles, ACI/TrueColor, lineweight and transparency with zero audit errors or fixes.
